svg.text: 80,000 CAMERAS · TIERED BY WHAT EACH CAMERA'S POSITION ALLOWS
56,000 · relayed only while watched · no continuous compute
≈ 7.5 GPU nodes per district, co-located with the district control room
Relay + analytics + local spool + crop store · video stays inside the district network
Node count = tier A ÷ 60 streams + tier B ÷ 250 streams, + 25% headroom (assumptions to be measured)
